about.heading: Welcome to Sri Bhashyam Public School
about.text1: Established with a commitment to academic excellence, moral integrity, and modern pedagogical practices, Sri Bhashyam Public School offers a nurturing environment for students from Nursery through Class X.
about.text2: Our state-of-the-board curriculum focuses on holistic growth, integrating conceptual academic grounding with sports, technology, and cultural values.
about.quote: Education is the most powerful weapon which you can use to change the world.

chairman.name: V. Naga Subba Reddy
chairman.message: Welcome to Sri Bhashyam Public School. Our mission is to empower young minds with high moral standards, analytical capabilities, and leadership qualities. We believe every child possesses unique potential waiting to be unlocked.

visionMission.visionText: To nurture confident, compassionate, and responsible individuals who excel academically, think creatively, embrace innovation, and contribute positively to society and the nation.
visionBullets: Bridge academic theory with actual practical exposure

values.title: Academic Excellence
values.description: Delivering conceptual clarity, rigorous assessment routines, and competitive edge in state & national standards.

values.title: Moral Integrity & Ethics
values.description: Instilling truthfulness, discipline, respect for elders, and traditional Indian moral values.

values.title: Holistic Development
values.description: Balancing academic studies with sports, cultural arts, public speaking, and physical fitness.

values.title: Innovation & Critical Thinking
values.description: Encouraging scientific inquiry, practical problem-solving, and independent analytical capabilities.

high.lead: Rigorous academic preparation for Board Examinations and future competitive success.
high.title: High School (Class IX to Class X)
high.description: Comprehensive curriculum aligned with state standards, emphasizing in-depth subject mastery, systematic revision plans, mock assessments, and personalized exam orientation.

middle.lead: Empowering critical thinking, scientific curiosity, and experiential conceptual clarity.
middle.title: Middle School (Class VI to Class VIII)
middle.description: Middle school builds strong subject foundations across Mathematics, Sciences, Social Studies, and Languages, integrating practical laboratory sessions, project work, and interactive problem solving.

competitive.lead: Special focus batches preparing students for medical and engineering entrance exams.
competitive.title: NEET & JEE Integrated Prep
competitive.description: Integrated coaching embedded within regular school hours to strengthen Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics/Biology concepts for national competitive entrance tests.

little-champs.lead: Foundational learning encouraging curiosity, active exploration, and creative skill development.
little-champs.title: Little Champs (Nursery to Class V)
little-champs.description: Our primary program focuses on activity-based and play-way methods. We nurture fundamental literacy, numeracy, social skills, and creative thinking in a safe, vibrant environment.

facilities.title: Interactive Smart Classrooms
facilities.description: Digitally equipped classrooms with audio-visual learning tools and interactive smart boards for immersive learning.

facilities.title: Hi-Tech Science Laboratories
facilities.description: Fully equipped Physics, Chemistry, and Biology labs enabling practical experiments and scientific exploration.

facilities.title: Computer & Digital Innovation Hub
facilities.description: Modern computer lab with high-speed connectivity, programming environments, and digital literacy training.

facilities.title: Library & Knowledge Resource Center
facilities.description: Vast repository of academic textbooks, reference journals, literature, encyclopedias, and digital learning assets.

facilities.title: Sports & Athletic Arena
facilities.description: Expansive outdoor play fields and indoor sports facilities supporting athletics, cricket, volleyball, chess, and karate.

facilities.title: Safe & Monitored Campus Transport
facilities.description: Fleet of GPS-tracked school buses covering key locations across Kadapa with trained drivers and attendants.

testimonials.quote: Sri Bhashyam Public School provides an outstanding learning environment. Teachers pay individual attention to every student and encourage moral values along with top-grade academics.
The NEET & JEE foundation program is fantastic. My son has developed immense confidence in Math and Science thanks to the dedicated faculty members.
A perfect blend of modern smart classrooms, discipline, and cultural heritage. We are extremely happy with our daughter's progress over the years.
